children: Oman’s Petroleum Development Oman (PDO) has awarded US-based Weatherford a three-year integrated drilling services contract covering 274 wells in Marmul and the Greater Saqr Area, local Arabic language news portal Atheer reported on Monday.
The contract includes oil production and water-injection wells, as well as small fields that will be developed using a standardised development model, the report said.

Weatherford will execute the drilling programme in phases, with the contracting model designed to improve planning and optimise the allocation of drilling rigs and other resources across the targeted fields.

The model is expected to reduce costs by around 20 percent compared with traditional pricing models, while providing greater cost control and clearer accountability for execution and results, according to the report.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
